title: metadata-protocol: follow-ups from the #35450 contract review: the spec exception text, three door-request comments, and a rollback pin over real history
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbP6iSEGkWb5fn8yqd

Filing gate ①: nits N4–N6 of contract review 7011078775 on PR #35450 (card #34681, VERDICT PASS at `914e61af`, no must-fix or should-fix). The seat asked for them as one p3.

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：没有。这张卡只补说明文字和一条测试。
- 为什么做：写操作跟随基座包修好后，规范说明漏了两种情形，几处代码注释还按旧规则写。
- 出错会怎样：不改的话，读文档或注释的人会以为按名字写一律被拒。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Items
- **N4.** The row-held-base exception in the five `packageId` descriptions in `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` omits the case of a name no package ships in code, and assumes exactly one dependent. Widen the sentence to cover both, then regenerate `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`.
- **N5.** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-door-requests.ts:67-69`, `:119-121` and `:151-152` still state the two-package refusal with no row-held-base exception. Align the comments with the shipped behaviour.
- **N6.** The read-only-base rollback pin in `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-bare-write-doors-follow-base-34681.test.ts` runs over rows with no history. Seed a history row so that the pin exercises a real rollback.

Related: #34681 (parent), PR #35450.
Suggested-grade: p3.
